title: Materials for Energy & Sustainability
short: Batteries, hydrogen and cleaner metallurgy — materials for a lower-carbon industry.
overview: Materials sit at the centre of the energy transition. Research in this area covers rechargeable battery and solid-electrolyte materials, hydrogen generation and storage alloys, solid oxide fuel cell components and other materials for clean energy technologies.
Sustainability runs through the department’s metallurgy as well: metal recycling, recovery of value from industrial waste, hydrogen-based processing and lower-energy routes for iron and steel.
